description: A black Cadillac limousine with a small American flag and a presidential-style emblem on the front drives on a wet, grey avenue. A line of dark-coated figures stands along the far kerb, with bare winter trees and the White House visible in the background. In the foreground, empty dark stadium-style bleacher seats with black bunting sit beside a wicker basket of peanuts resting on one seat. The scene is a rainy, muted, painterly view with no visible text.
